motion.evidence: Largely static. Only 4 @keyframes, all third-party utilities (Swiper swipe-out; Sonner toast fade-in/fade-out/spin) — NO bespoke hero/scroll keyframes. No GSAP/Lenis/Framer; canvas 0; cursor-followers 0. Probes: 3 IntersectionObservers / 394 targets at rootMargin 200px + threshold 0 (lazy-image loading, not reveals), 41 rAF, 58 mousemove (Swiper drag), 3 scroll listeners, 1 prefers-reduced-motion block (respected). Interactive: 3 carousels, 15 marquees, 4 tabs, 7 disclosure, 1 video, 0 draggable, 0 canvas. scroll_effects after dropping from==to noise: 1 sticky pin (nav) + 3 transform/parallax (story/testimonial cards); hero opacity 0→1 at 150ms is the one real entrance. Long durations 30s–90s drive the marquee loops. Frames corroborate: s00 hero, s03 customer-story cards bleeding off both edges (marquee/carousel), s06 tabbed Table-Editor in an OS-shell frame, nav persistent s00→s09.

notes: Normalized from a light-theme profile. Raw fg/muted/border came as rgb() — converted to hex and named into a 5-step gray ramp (fg #171717 → muted #525252 → subtle #707070 → faint #b2b2b2 → border #dfdfdf). Single accent green #3fcf8e is the brand 'go' color (rationed to CTA/code/headline/success); #00bb68 is the slightly deeper inline-link green kept as accent-strong. accent-fg is intentionally DARK (#171717) not white, because the accent is a light hue — confirmed by the green primary button rendering near-black text in the hero screenshot. The radius value 3.35544e+07px in the raw profile is the browser's clamp artifact for a full pill → normalized to 9999px. Profile reported essentially one weight (400 dominant, 500 occasional); hero display headline (72px) and section heads (36px) confirm hierarchy is scale-driven, not weight-driven. Shadows are effectively absent on hero/sections — depth is a single hairline border; kept only a faint sm shadow that some cards use. Section vertical padding observed at 96px/128px, hence the large top of the space scale.
